content.short: SmartState offers NDA-protected security audits for blockchain projects.
content.description: SmartState delivers in-depth analysis of code and business logic for complex blockchain projects. Exploits are crafted by humans, so white-hat experts conduct manual security audits in addition to automated checks to uncover vulnerabilities that automated tools may miss. The team has audited more than 300 blockchain projects, with clients including EYWA, 1inch, Binance, and KuCoin. To date, none of the audited code has been hacked.
content.meta: SmartState delivers NDA-protected, top-tier security audits for blockchain projects. Discover SmartState and other Web3 Security Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
